title: Daily finance score from four KP sub lord layers

fields.name: birthDate
fields.description: Birth date, YYYY-MM-DD. Fixes the Placidus cusps, the four tier significators and the Vimshottari balance every layer reads.

fields.name: birthTime
fields.description: Birth time, HH:MM:SS, 24 hour, local to the birth place. The cusp sub lords move about one sub every four minutes of clock time, so this is the input the whole reading is most sensitive to.

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: Birth latitude in decimal degrees. Sets the Placidus cusps; also the place the ruling planets and the Moon windows are read at.

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: Birth longitude in decimal degrees, east positive.

fields.name: timezone
fields.description: Timezone as an IANA name (Asia/Kolkata) or decimal hours from UTC. Applies to the birth time, to the reading date and time, and to every local timestamp in the response. IANA names resolve to the offset in force on the date being read.

fields.name: date
fields.description: Civil date to read, YYYY-MM-DD in the request timezone. Defaults to today (UTC). The Moon windows cover this date from midnight to midnight.

fields.name: time
fields.description: Reading moment on that date, HH:MM:SS local. The ruling planets and the running sookshma lord are read at this instant. Defaults to 12:00:00; pass a market open or any hour for an intraday read.

fields.name: ayanamsa
fields.description: Ayanamsa system for sidereal conversion. "kp-newcomb" uses the KP-Newcomb dynamic formula, the most common choice for KP astrology. "kp-old" uses the Krishnamurti original table from KP Reader-1 with constant precession rate. "lahiri" uses Lahiri/Chitrapaksha ayanamsa, matching most traditional Vedic software. "raman" uses the B.V. Raman ayanamsa from Hindu Predictive Astrology, a recognised traditional school that sits about 1.45 degrees below Lahiri. Defaults to "kp-newcomb".

fields.name: nodeType
fields.description: Lunar node convention. "mean" is the smoothed average node, which always moves retrograde; "true" is the osculating node, which tracks the real perturbed node, oscillates up to about 1.5 degrees either side of the mean on a 173-day cycle, and can briefly turn direct. Neither is more correct and they almost always fall in the same sign. Applies to the Rahu and Ketu positions. Mean is the traditional Vedic default and what printed panchangs use; the choice can move a KP sub-lord in narrow boundary cases, where a span can be as small as 0.5 degrees. Defaults to "mean".

fields.name: gainHouses
fields.description: Houses whose significators count as gain, 1 to 12. Defaults to the convention, 2 and 11. Override it to run your own school: the two lists may not share a house.

fields.name: lossHouses
fields.description: Houses whose significators count as loss, 1 to 12. Defaults to the convention, 6 and 8 and 12. Override it to run your own school: the two lists may not share a house.

fields.name: cusps
fields.description: Percent of the final score the cusps layer carries.

fields.name: dasha
fields.description: Percent of the final score the dasha layer carries.

fields.name: rulingPlanets
fields.description: Percent of the final score the rulingPlanets layer carries.

fields.name: moonWindows
fields.description: Percent of the final score the moonWindows layer carries.
